title: My Yoeleo G21 Altera Gravel Bike is FINISHED!

takeaways.text: Supplied by Yoeleo with its wheels. The owner fitted a 2× Shimano road Di2 group (50/34, 11–34) without extra bottom-bracket spacers; the clutchless road derailleur gave no chain drops on Midwest gravel.

Rides a size 56 with a 140 mm road stem and 38 cm bar for reach, which he says suits fast open gravel but is slow-steering on singletrack; the round 27.2 mm post and a ported headset cover allow third-party cockpits.
Continental 45 mm tires measured exactly 45 mm on 27 mm-internal rims; he says a 53 mm tire would hit the front-derailleur wire, so the 53 mm figure needs 1×.
Fit and finish were excellent: no creaks or rattles, calipers aligned with no shimming, clean T47 threads, and the easiest internal routing he had done thanks to the removable storage hatch.
After about six weeks: very comfortable, planted and stable; he quotes about US$1,500 for the frameset before his discount code.

disclosure: The creator thanks Yoeleo for the frameset and the description lists discount codes for several brands.
summary: Finished-build review comparing the G21 with the creator's cheaper Tantan gravel frame on fit, ride over rough pavement and customer experience.
